notes.title: Graphics Upgrade Incoming – Version 0.6 Moves to URP

Oki Aki[/p]

notes.title: Legendary Knight – Update 0.5.0: A Grand Return
notes.content:
[p]In this update, I’ve made significant improvements to both the game’s visuals and stability.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/bd1c487e1fe03a264b07309fcff36675c8978648.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Main Menu UI[/b] has been completely redesigned to present a cleaner and more modern look, making it easier for players to navigate right from the start.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/5e00aa21bc35771e66281e3819539bbdeb32fcad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I’ve also [b]updated the Barrack UI[/b] with improved visuals and better layout, allowing for a more intuitive and enjoyable experience when managing your units.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/5b4671f61f3d99943f4de6db9cdeebfbd97500fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]in-game HUD[/b] has been refreshed to provide better readability, ensuring that important information is easier to track during gameplay without cluttering the screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/53f804c2636193ada73b0df6fb94076178f202d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Finally, I’ve fixed numerous bugs across different parts of the game, improving the overall stability and ensuring smoother performance.[/p][p][/p][p]--[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/8ac5ae0f5c748b2ec06e88c60c7f20fd4f2b4d77.jpg"][/img]Thank you all for your support since the release of [i]Legendary Knight[/i] in 2020. After many years, I have finally returned to the path of indie game development. The last update for [i]Legendary Knight[/i] was in 2022, and I never imagined I’d meet everyone again after such a long time. I hope you can drop by and check it out when you have the chance. I’m actively posting updates on various social media platforms, and I hope you will continue to support me.

Love,
Oki Aki @ Oki Game Lab[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Major update V0.4.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/36ea9637f6b0fabf7076f2e6069d81fb256403aa.png[/img]
Happy Lunar New Year! I wish you all good health and all the best!
Legendary Knight also welcomes the first major update on this happy day - Endless Mode is now available!
I have put a lot of effort into this update, almost like redoing the game all over again, that's why it took me so long to see you all again.

The following is the main content of version 0.4.0

[h1]New mode: endless city defense[/h1]
Our defeat is certain, but we must win anyway. The enemy will continue to attack until the city is breached. Pick up your weapons and give the enemy the heaviest resist!
Or will the dawn comes?

[h1]New map[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/d2f7b639aae9ee8864bd50d83ca6acffb71f762a.png[/img]
As a summary of the Legendary Knight, a new map is necessary, larger battles, and more war-like scenarios.

[h1]Card system[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/159bc33d1aedefcafca3603df17185ee44fb2320.png[/img]
Instead of the building upgrade system in the classic mode, players don't need to run back and forth in the map, faster game rhythm, more variety, and even allows players to perform special element attacks.

[h1]More character choices[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/4a4b3c7cb3b61aaea6db4c47464b7cc5b77ccd9a.png[/img]
With different unique attributes and auxiliary cards, choose the most suitable general for the city according to your battle style.

[h1]Building occupation system[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/d9b3a2493e8c7ffc779c90310cbde2574ceefe6b.png[/img]
In the endless mode, the three functional buildings will be temporarily occupied by the enemy, and regaining controls will give you special buffs, allowing players to persist in this siege battle longer.

[h1]Scoring system[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/689259e4781755982f916e266b100cb23348f643.jpg[/img]
Scores are given according to the player’s performance while defending the city. The evaluation elements include the number of enemies killed, time to stay, experience gained, and the number of soldiers killed. 

Thank you for your support

[h1]PS: About the master DLC situation[/h1]
Due to the time required for approval, the master in endless mode cannot be unlocked temporarily, please be patient

notes.title: Legendary Knight V0.3.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/de100813e1c33abe58ea40dbbdbd34ec9e61c2ec.png[/img]
Legendary Knights V0.3.1 Update (2020-06-18).
[olist]
[*](Fixed) Soldiers in Fortress Mine teleport to the wall
[*](Fixed) Enemies fall off from the dock in Village wave 16
[*](Fixed) King's HP Level II skills invalid conditions
[*](Fixed) Fortress Victory Screen Problem
[*]Adding Sensitivity option
[*]Options will be saved automatically
[*]The skip function will be temporarily locked during a shopping pause
[/olist]

1. Soldiers in Fortress Mine teleport to the wall
At the fortress map, soldiers appeared to fly up to the wall, and the problem is now under control, but not fully resolved. But at least I gave them a way to get back to the ground after they flew up.

2. Enemies fall off from the dock in Village wave 16
Soldiers sometimes fall out of the dock because of problems with the development software. Now there is a way to deal with those unfortunate soldiers who fall into the water and let them return to the map.

3. King's HP Level II skills invalid conditions
The problem has been fixed.

4. Game options update
Sensitivity adjustments have been added and all options changes by the player will be saved automatically.

5. The skip function will be temporarily locked during a shopping pause
Now if the player is in a store, they cannot skip the prep time in order to prevent the previous screen freezing issue.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: I started my dream at this workbench
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/1c2d983e6d15eb30d15d53449f89a1b47c072170.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone, it's been a while again.
Because of a little incident yesterday that stirred up some emotions, I wanted to share the story behind Legendary Knight with you.

I started developing Legendary Knights in September 2019 with doubts and with nothing left in my bank account. With few circumstances, I decided to start what I had always dreamed of. Before Legendary Knight, I had never tried to complete a game of this scale (I had once created a mini-game called Clicks, which was also written in Unity). I can't even imagine that after six months, I actually managed to get it on Steam.

In November 2018, I decided to leave my first job after graduation to try to fulfill two of my dreams, one of which was game development. I've been going back and forth for half a year, and I've suffered a lot, but I've never thought about giving up, even though I'm barely earning any money. People are telling me that I should find a full-time job, fulfill my dream only when I have spare time.

However, I deeply understand that it is impossible to finish a game with spare time. It is already tiring enough to work, so why would I put in more effort to develop it after work? I knew that unless I was willing to put in 100% effort, I wouldn't be able to succeed.

Then from September 2019 to March 2020, I spent almost 12 hours a day working on the game, 7 days a week. Occasionally, when I get really tired, I take a day or two off. You can see the workbench in my room from above. When I was tired, I would go to bed and rest; when I woke up, I would get back to work on the other side in my room.

Due to the lack of experience and confidence, I adopted the "Done is better than perfect" approach. No good plan, no good programming structure, no professional Unity skills. I've used every simple, easy way to make sure my first indie game project can be done. The game isn't perfect, but I can't accept myself giving up in the halfway.

I'm proud of myself for actually completing the early access version, and Legendary Knights is my first creation. The only thing I regret is that I took the "Done is better than perfect" approach at first. The whole project is extremely messy, which makes it extremely difficult for me to update and add new game elements now. But I'll always try my best to finish Legendary Knight, I just need more time.

Also, I'm working on my second project, which I'll share on my Facebook page and Youtube Channel in the future, so please support me if you're interested.

The purpose of Oki Game Lab is not only to create games, but also to share various indie games with you! Not only my creations, there are thousands of other great projects out there, and they may have different stories behind them. That's why the Oki Game Lab is trying to give free reviews and advice to some indie creators.

We have created a Curator on Steam and started a website to record the reviews we have done. If you are interested in learning more about games, please follow our Steam Curator.

I just need a little more time and I'm not giving up on my first child!

Once again, thank you all for your support of Legendary Knight!

Legendary Knight V0.3.0 Updates (2020-04-18):
[olist]
[*] Full support for the French interface
[*] New main menu design
[*] The King can push his soldiers
[*] Enemy Knights will not dodge
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/d63c348792e7d72d4fad5bf58f0cf8b5add65545.png[/img]
1. Full support for the French interface (Thx Mathiue)
Starting from V0.3.0, the game will be fully supported in French, and new players can also set the default game language to French via Steam's settings. Thanks to Mathiue, our Discord administrator. He is from France and has prepared everything for this new change. 

2. New main menu design
We have a new main menu design. This is in preparation for the next new game mode.

3. The King can push his soldiers (Thx Orbnotacus)
During the game, we were often blocked in the battlefield by our own men. Now the king can push his men away and move on.

4. Enemy Knights will not dodge (Thx Orbnotacus)
Knights in full plate armor, and armed with great swords, sometimes appear too powerful. Our king is even more powerless when they block his attacks and then flamboyantly dodge his second and third attacks.  With this in mind, we issue a new instruction to all knights, do not dodge in battle!

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Legendary Knight V0.1.3 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/f1d19622217813f0f7cb215ad1f9b603e89727fb.png[/img]
Legendary Knight V0.1.3 Updates (2020-03-03):
[olist]
[*] Shopping Pause
[*] Invert Y
[*] Now can use ESC key to close popups (Shops and command panel)
[*] Skills that cannot be researched yet will display being locked
[*] Now item shop will show how many items you have in the moment.
[/olist]

This version update is all about enhancement of shops.

1. Shopping Pause (Thx Commander)
I have noticed that it is very difficult for new player to finish all actions in just 50 seconds. So now I have added a feature that when player enter a shop (item, skills, building upgrade or barrack), the game will stop. You can disable this feature in settings in case you would like to challenge yourself.

2. Invert Y (Thx Redlovedfr)
Now players can enable invert-Y in Options.

3. ESC key can close popups
To be honest, even I make mistake sometimes when I want to close a shop, I press the ESC key. Now you can close both shop popups and command panel with the ESC key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/15b3398de21aacd8c8178f390dd7a2d5220a3d04.png[/img]
4. Locked the skills that cannot be researched yet
A better display to let you know those skills cannot be reached yet. I put a little lock on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/cf3821918d01161ed094e2e0abd3a70a225152b3.png[/img]
5. Item shop will show how many items you have in the moment
Players have a hard time when buying items that they don't know how many army potions are in their pocket. You will have no problem with it anymore. Amounts are shown in the item shop.

Damn...... I push myself to finish all these features within a short period of time. Because I understand that some of the problems really hurt the user experience. Now I need some sleep..... If you have any questions or looking for enhancements, feel free to leave your comments here or in the forum.

Thanks for your support!
